title: Open Values Rating v0.1
description: One option's score on one criterion, from 0 to 100. It is written either as a bare number, or null for unknown, or as a small record that also carries the criterion's key and the score's source.

key.description: The key of the criterion this score is for, as declared in the facts file's criteria.

value.description: The score, from 0 to 100. null means unknown, which is not the same as 0.

provenance.description: How the score is known: a short note, or a citation with note, source link and date.
